categoryReasons.schemaAndBindings: The name and country bindings map to the correct manual request parameters, though neither TextInput declares a defaultValue.
categoryReasons.apiAndRequestDesign: The single request uses the verified Agify source, inherited apikey authentication, GET /, and the documented name and country_id parameter mappings.
categoryReasons.runtimeCompatibility: The manual SubFetch, bounded regex validation, and safe number formatting fit the runtime, while the bound controls omit the documented explicit defaults.
categoryReasons.goalFulfillment: The widget provides a manual full-name estimate with optional two-letter country scoping, evidence count, uncertainty copy, and initial/no-result states.
categoryReasons.visualQuality: A prominent estimate and separated evidence/caveat text create useful hierarchy, but the plain stacked composition remains visually generic.
categoryReasons.responsiveAndTheme: The vertical form and truncating name handle constrained width, but nowrap groups around the title and 30px estimate may crowd a very narrow tile.
categoryReasons.loadingEmptyErrorSuccess: The initial prompt and null-age state are explicit, and SubFetch owns loading, errors, and retry while the callback renders successful estimates.
categoryReasons.dailyUsefulness: One request and a short manual form make repeated lookups straightforward, though invalid country text is silently treated as no scope and the overall UI is prototype-like.
categoryReasons.complexityDiscipline: A single request and shared result callback avoid duplicate manifests and keep the query flow restrained.
categoryReasons.accessibility: Both controls have visible labels and the custom trigger has an aria-label, with evidence and uncertainty supplied in readable text.
categoryReasons.actionSafety: The estimate runs only after a manual trigger and the API key is configured through source authentication, with no automatic action.

strengths: Correct Agify endpoint, source-level authentication, and response parameter mapping.
One manual request handles both scoped and unscoped lookups without duplicate render paths.
The estimate, evidence count, country, and population-level caveat are shown as text.
SubFetch supplies loading and failure/retry behavior, and the initial and no-age states are explicit.
problems: Malformed country text is silently omitted from the query, so the user may believe a country filter was applied when it was not.
The bound fields omit explicit defaults.
The visual treatment is simple and the nowrap result group may feel cramped in a narrow tile.
highestImpactFixes: Surface invalid country input rather than silently running an unscoped lookup.
Declare defaults for both bound inputs.
Allow the estimate/evidence row to adapt at narrow widths and add a little more visual distinction to the result.
